Data.title: Details Of Balance Sheet Of Corporate Sector (End Of Period), Annual
Data.footnote: The industries are classified according to Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025.  Please refer to the Technical Notes (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/industry/enterprises-and-corporate-sector/our-data-explained) for more information on the methodology and concepts of Singapore’s Corporate Sector. Total Assets Of Corporate Sector By Detailed Industry (End Of Period) - Data for detailed industries have been discontinued with effect from April 2026.  Total Equity Of Corporate Sector By Detailed Industry (End Of Period) - Data for detailed industries have been discontinued with effect from April 2026.
